roadmap.title: Story and chapter-limited tasks
roadmap.description: Play the story with manual chapter saves, maintain enough Honor for Chapter 6, and finish every camp-limited activity, request, donation, and optional Honor mission before its cutoff.

roadmap.title: Post-story completion
roadmap.description: Use the fully opened map to complete the 100% checklist, medals, Stranger strands, bounties, collectibles, graves, hunting requests, crafting, games, spending, and fishing.

roadmap.title: Animal compendium and bear grind
roadmap.description: Sweep the main-map animal compendium for every required study and skin entry, then farm qualifying bear maul-and-kill sequences.

roadmap.title: Red Dead Online
roadmap.description: Complete onboarding, combine awards and economy tasks with the Rank 50 XP route, and organize other PC players for posse, rival-mission, and MVP requirements.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 1.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Chapter 1} and leave the Grizzlies with the gang.

guide.context: This is an automatic story unlock, so Chapter 1's optional Gold Medal objectives are unnecessary.

steps.text: Advance the main story through @mechanic{Eastward Bound}; the achievement registers at the transition out of Chapter 1.

achievements.description: Complete Enter, Pursued by a Memory.
achievements.summary: Complete the Chapter 1 story mission @mechanic{Enter, Pursued by a Memory}.

guide.context: This automatic opening-story unlock does not require the mission's optional Gold Medal objectives.

steps.text: Follow the Chapter 1 story until @mechanic{Enter, Pursued by a Memory}, rescue John with Javier, and finish the mission.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Chapter 2} and move the gang from Horseshoe Overlook.

guide.context: This is an automatic story unlock, but Chapter 2 contains several camp requests and activities that become unavailable later.

steps.text: Finish the required Chapter 2 story missions and reach the gang's move to @loc{Clemens Point}; the achievement registers at the chapter transition.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 3.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Chapter 3} and leave the gang's Clemens Point camp.

guide.context: This is an automatic story unlock, but one qualifying companion activity must be completed at Clemens Point before the move.

steps.text: Finish the required Chapter 3 story missions and reach the transition to @loc{Shady Belle}.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Chapter 4} and the Saint Denis bank-robbery sequence.

guide.context: The Chapter 4 transition permanently removes the gang tithing box and the remaining camp-request window.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Banking, the Old American Art} and its aftermath; the achievement registers when Chapter 5 begins.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 5.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Chapter 5} and return from Guarma to the mainland.

guide.context: Guarma-exclusive animals are not required for the animal achievements, so no island cleanup is needed before leaving.

steps.text: Complete the required Guarma and return missions through @mechanic{That's Murfree Country}; the achievement registers at the Chapter 6 transition.

achievements.description: Complete Goodbye, Dear Friend.
achievements.summary: Complete the Chapter 6 story mission @mechanic{Goodbye, Dear Friend}.

guide.context: This automatic story unlock does not require the mission's optional Gold Medal objectives.

steps.text: Advance Chapter 6 until @mechanic{Goodbye, Dear Friend} becomes available, then finish the mission.

achievements.description: Complete Red Dead Redemption.
achievements.summary: Complete the Chapter 6 finale @mechanic{Red Dead Redemption}.

guide.context: This automatic unlock marks the end of Chapter 6 and the transition to Epilogue Part 1.

steps.text: Finish the remaining Chapter 6 story missions and complete @mechanic{Red Dead Redemption}.

achievements.description: Complete A New Jerusalem.
achievements.summary: Complete the Epilogue Part 2 story mission @mechanic{A New Jerusalem}.

guide.context: This automatic epilogue unlock does not require the mission's optional Gold Medal objectives.

steps.text: Advance Epilogue Part 2 until @mechanic{A New Jerusalem} becomes available, then finish building the house.

achievements.description: Complete the Epilogue.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Epilogue Part 2} by finishing the final mission, @mechanic{American Venom}.

guide.context: Finishing the epilogue opens the post-story grave, hunting-request, New Austin, and full-map cleanup routes.

steps.text: Complete every required epilogue mission through @mechanic{American Venom}; the achievement registers when the story concludes.

achievements.description: Complete all optional Honor story missions.
achievements.summary: Complete every optional Honor story mission in one playthrough, including the Chapter 6 missions gated by @mechanic{Honor Rank 4}.

guide.context: Mission Replay does not award this achievement. Keep manual saves at each chapter start, and protect Honor Rank 4 for Do Not Seek Absolution.

steps.text: Clear Chapter 2's three-part @mechanic{Money Lending and Other Sins} debt sequence. Also finish @mechanic{Good, Honest, Snake Oil} and all three parts of @mechanic{We Loved Once and True}.
In Chapter 3, complete @mechanic{The Course of True Love I–III} and @mechanic{Money Lending and Other Sins IV}.

During Chapter 4, finish @mechanic{Help a Brother Out}; return later for its follow-up, @mechanic{Brothers and Sisters, One and All}. Clear both parts of @mechanic{Fatherhood and Other Dreams} and Part V of @mechanic{Money Lending and Other Sins}.

Enter Chapter 6 at @mechanic{Honor Rank 4}. Finish both parts of @mechanic{Do Not Seek Absolution} and @mechanic{Of Men and Angels}; then clear Parts IV–V of @mechanic{The Course of True Love}. During @mechanic{Archeology for Beginners}, accept @npc{Captain Monroe}'s request to open @mechanic{Honor, Amongst Thieves}. Finish Parts VI–VII of @mechanic{Money Lending and Other Sins} and both parts of @mechanic{Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow} before their markers disappear.

achievements.description: Attain 100% completion.
achievements.summary: Complete every requirement shown under @mechanic{Pause Menu > Progress > Total Completion} until the total reaches 100%.

guide.context: The checklist requires only selected compendium entries, but every listed collectible strand and all 90 challenge tasks are mandatory.

steps.text: Bring the story to its conclusion and finish 10 complete Stranger strands. Capture five bounties, experience 25 chance encounters and one gang ambush, and clear six gang hideouts.

For collectibles, inspect one point of interest and all nine graves. Gather all 30 dinosaur bones and complete one full set of 12 cigarette cards. Land all 13 legendary fish, inspect 10 rock carvings and 20 dreamcatchers, clear every @npc{Algernon Wasp} exotics list and hunting request, and finish one treasure chain.

Discover @mechanic{50 animals}, @mechanic{10 equipment pieces}, @mechanic{10 fish species}, @mechanic{6 gangs}, @mechanic{10 horse breeds}, @mechanic{20 plant types}, and use @mechanic{48 weapon types}.
Max Health, Stamina, Dead Eye, and one horse's bonding, then complete all @mechanic{90 tasks} across the nine challenge chains.

Find @mechanic{5 shacks}, kill @mechanic{5 legendary animals}, play all four table games, meet five ranters/ravers/campaigners, take a bath, watch a show, visit a theater, craft one recipe in each of six categories, and complete coach, home, shop, and train robberies. Confirm that every Total Completion category has a checkmark.

achievements.description: Earn 70 Gold Medals in Story missions.
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{70 Gold Medals} by completing every listed objective within each selected Story mission attempt.

guide.context: Objectives do not carry between attempts, and Mission Replay supplies preset equipment without tonics; manual saves before first-playthrough missions preserve a stronger loadout.

steps.text: Before each Story mission, make a manual save and note its Gold Medal objectives.
Complete every objective in the same mission attempt; reload the manual save and retry when an objective fails.
For cleanup, open @mechanic{Pause Menu > Progress > Story}, select a short mission, display its checklist, and replay it until Gold. Continue until the Gold Medal counter reaches 70.

achievements.description: Complete a Companion Activity in each camp.
achievements.estTime: one activity in each of Chapters 2–4
achievements.summary: Complete one qualifying camp companion activity in each of @mechanic{Chapters 2, 3, and 4}.

guide.context: Camp table games do not count, activity markers appear intermittently, and a later camp cannot replace a missed chapter.

steps.text: In Chapter 2, complete @npc{Charles}'s bison hunt or @npc{Javier}'s home robbery.
In Chapter 3, complete @npc{Sean}'s or @npc{Bill}'s coach robbery, @npc{Javier}'s or @npc{Kieran}'s fishing trip, or Javier's carried-over home robbery.
In Chapter 4, complete @npc{Micah}'s or @npc{Lenny}'s coach robbery, @npc{Pearson}'s hunt, or @npc{Uncle}'s cattle robbery. Sleep or advance the story if no activity marker is present.

achievements.description: Play all mini games.
achievements.summary: Start a round of @mechanic{Five Finger Fillet}, @mechanic{Blackjack}, @mechanic{Dominoes}, and @mechanic{Poker} in Story Mode.

guide.context: Winning or completing a match is unnecessary; Total Completion > Table Games records each game as soon as play begins.

steps.text: Start Five Finger Fillet in @loc{Strawberry} and Blackjack in the @loc{Rhodes saloon}.
Start Dominoes in the @loc{Saint Denis park} and Poker in the @loc{Saint Denis saloon}, then verify all four entries in the @mechanic{Table Games} checklist inside Total Completion.

achievements.description: Recover the stash from 4 homesteads.
achievements.summary: Recover the credited stash from four homesteads, such as @loc{Chez Porter}, @loc{Watson's Cabin}, @loc{Lonnie's Shack}, and @loc{Catfish Jacksons}.

guide.context: Do these from Chapter 2 onward while the occupants are available, and collect the specific stash rather than generic household loot.

steps.text: Rob @loc{Chez Porter} with @npc{Javier}, climb the barn ladder, and open the stash box beside the upper-floor haystacks.
Enter @loc{Watson's Cabin}, climb into the cellar, and take the shotgun that counts as its stash.
At @loc{Lonnie's Shack}, kill three occupants, threaten the survivor, and collect the stash location he reveals.
At @loc{Catfish Jacksons}, threaten the son and collect the revealed stash from the living-room fireplace or the crate outside the entrance. Confirm the fourth credit registers.

achievements.description: Discover the fate of Marko Dragic.
achievements.summary: Finish @mechanic{A Bright Bouncing Boy I–II}, wait two in-game days, and find @npc{Marko Dragic}'s body in his northern laboratory.

guide.context: Part I appears in Saint Denis during Chapter 4 by day; Part II appears at the laboratory only at night.

steps.text: During Chapter 4 in daylight, meet @npc{Marko Dragic} in @loc{Saint Denis} and complete @mechanic{A Bright Bouncing Boy I}.
At night, travel to Dragic's laboratory in the northeast, enter through the back door, complete @mechanic{A Bright Bouncing Boy II}, and place all three lightning rods.
Pass two in-game days, return to the laboratory, and approach Dragic's body on the floor.

achievements.description: Rob or loot $250.
achievements.summary: Accumulate @mechanic{$250} by robbing targets or looting defeated enemies in Story Mode.

guide.context: The counter persists across the save, but ordinary shop income does not replace robbery or looting credit.

steps.text: Loot defeated enemies and robbed targets throughout story missions until the cumulative amount taken reaches @mechanic{$250}.

achievements.description: Donate $250 to the gang tithing box.
achievements.summary: Personally donate a cumulative @mechanic{$250} to the gang tithing box before the end of @mechanic{Chapter 4}.

guide.context: The tithing box exists only in Chapters 2–4, and donations made by other gang members do not count.

steps.text: At the camp ledger's tithing box, choose @mechanic{Contribute} and personally add cash or valuables until Arthur's cumulative contribution reaches $250.

achievements.description: Spend $5000 across all shops.
achievements.summary: Spend a cumulative @mechanic{$5,000} at Story Mode shops, stables, or gunsmiths.

guide.context: Reloading a manual save after the achievement appears restores the money without removing the unlock.

steps.text: Accumulate at least $5,000. Open the pause screen, select @mechanic{Story}, and use @mechanic{Save Game} to create a manual save.
Buy horses, weapons, upgrades, clothing, or supplies until total shop spending reaches $5,000, then reload the manual save if the money is needed elsewhere.

achievements.description: Reach maximum or minimum Honor level.
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum or minimum Story Mode Honor cap after completing @mechanic{Paradise Mercifully Departed}.

guide.context: The full cap is unavailable before late Chapter 5, and preserving high Honor until Chapter 6 protects the missions required for Lending a Hand.

steps.text: Maintain at least @mechanic{Honor Rank 4} until the Chapter 6 optional Honor missions are complete.

After @mechanic{Paradise Mercifully Departed}, repeatedly catch and release fish for Honor until the bar reaches its rightmost cap. Alternatively, make a manual save and commit dishonorable actions until the bar reaches its leftmost cap.

achievements.description: Complete 10 Stranger mission strands.
achievements.summary: Complete every part of @mechanic{10 multi-part Stranger mission strands}; single encounters do not count.

guide.context: Follow-up markers can require story progress, proximity, a specific time of day, or an in-game delay, and the unlock can arrive after the displayed tenth strand.

steps.text: Visit white question-mark Stranger markers and complete every mission in each chosen character's questline.
Check @mechanic{Pause Menu > Progress > Total Completion > Strangers} after finishing each strand.
If the achievement does not register when the counter first reaches 10, finish another qualifying multi-part Stranger strand.

achievements.description: Survive 3 days holding a bounty of $250 in all states.
achievements.summary: Hold @mechanic{$250 bounties} in @loc{Lemoyne}, @loc{New Hanover}, @loc{Ambarino}, and @loc{West Elizabeth} for three days without paying them; add @loc{New Austin} after the epilogue.

guide.context: New Austin's automatic story wanted status covers that region before the epilogue; once the epilogue removes it, creating a fifth $250 bounty covers the stricter post-story counter.

steps.text: Create a manual save, then commit witnessed crimes in @loc{Lemoyne}, @loc{New Hanover}, and @loc{West Elizabeth} until each map bounty reaches at least $250.

For @loc{Ambarino}, carry a victim onto a road, wait for a traveler to report the body, and defeat responding lawmen until its bounty reaches $250. If the epilogue is complete, create a $250 bounty in @loc{New Austin} as well.
Do not pay any bounty. Sleep or pass time until three complete in-game days elapse and the achievement appears, then restore the manual save if desired.

achievements.description: Complete one of the Collectable strands.
achievements.summary: Finish one complete collectible strand, such as all @mechanic{10 rock carvings} for @npc{Francis Sinclair}.

guide.context: Rock carvings are the shortest qualifying strand; the final mailing and return visit are required, not just the ten inspections.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Francis Sinclair} at his cabin northwest of @loc{Strawberry} to start @mechanic{Geology for Beginners}.
Inspect all 10 rock carvings and mail every coordinate to Sinclair from a post office.
Read Sinclair's invitation after it arrives, return to his cabin, and finish the Stranger strand.

achievements.description: Find the graves of each fallen companion.
achievements.summary: After completing the story, inspect all @mechanic{nine fallen-companion graves} across the map.

guide.context: The graves become collectible only after American Venom and can be visited in any order; Hosea and Lenny require separate interactions.

steps.text: Inspect @npc{Jenny Kirk} at @loc{Spider Gorge}, @npc{Davey Callander} in the @loc{Colter} church graveyard, and @npc{Eagle Flies} on the cliff at @loc{Donner Falls}.
Inspect @npc{Arthur Morgan} on the hill above @loc{Mysterious Hill Home} and @npc{Susan Grimshaw} near @loc{Elysian Pool}.

Inspect @npc{Hosea Matthews} and @npc{Lenny Summers} separately under the swamp tree, @npc{Kieran Duffy} in the meadow east of @loc{Braithwaite Manor}, and @npc{Sean MacGuire} beside @loc{Flat Iron Lake} near Rhodes.

achievements.description: Deliver 5 camp companion item requests.
achievements.summary: Fulfill five named camp companion item requests before the Chapter 4 camp ends.

guide.context: Requests usually trigger while speaking with companions at camp between 08:00 and 20:00 after their introductory story missions.

steps.text: In Chapter 2, trigger @npc{Abigail}'s request and give her $5, then give @npc{Jack} a @item{Penny Dreadful} from @loc{Osman Grove} east of Emerald Ranch.
Give @npc{Sean} @item{Kentucky Bourbon} and @npc{Bill} @item{Hair Pomade}; both items can be bought from general stores.
Pick two @item{Oregano}, trigger @npc{Susan}'s request, and give her both plants. Confirm all five deliveries before completing Chapter 4.

achievements.description: Find a permanent home for the squirrel statue.
achievements.summary: Complete all five @npc{Ms. Hobbs} hunting requests, place the squirrel statue at Beecher's Hope, and recover it from @loc{Mount Shann}.

guide.context: Every mailed carcass must be perfect and remain unskinned or unplucked; the fifth request and statue sequence require the epilogue.

steps.text: Take a @item{Hunters Sought} poster from a train-station post office, collect every perfect carcass on all five request lists, and mail each completed set to @npc{Ms. Hobbs}.
Read Hobbs's invitation, visit her house northeast of @loc{Strawberry}, receive the squirrel statue, and place it above the fireplace at @loc{Beecher's Hope}.

Pass 24 hours after each placement and recover the statue in order from John's bedroom chest, John's bedroom chimney, the loft chest reached by the kitchen ladder, the wheelbarrow beside the sheep barn, and the barn's upper chest.
After the sixth disappearance, climb to the summit of @loc{Mount Shann} and pick up the squirrel statue.

achievements.description: Craft 30 unique items in Story Mode.
achievements.summary: Craft @mechanic{30 different recipes} in Story Mode; repeated copies of one recipe do not count.

guide.context: Recipes come from story progress, fences, pamphlets, and harvested animal materials, so several crafting categories can contribute.

steps.text: Use a wilderness rest spot or campfire and open @mechanic{Craft/Cook}.
Produce distinct foods, tonics, ammunition types, hunting items, horse-care items, and weapons, selecting only recipes not previously crafted until 30 unique outputs register.

achievements.description: Skin every species of animal in Story Mode.
achievements.summary: Skin every skinnable animal required by @mechanic{Pause Menu > Progress > Compendium > Animals} in Story Mode.

guide.context: Species without a skin interaction—small animals collected whole and birds that are only plucked—are unnecessary, as are Guarma's exclusive parrots, boas, and Red-footed Booby.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Compendium > Animals} and identify each species with an unfinished skin entry.
Hunt and skin every eligible species on the main map; find the @enemy{Cuban Land Crab} and @enemy{Green Iguana} on the largest island east of @loc{Flat Iron Lake}.
Recheck the compendium after each regional sweep and finish every remaining required skin entry.

achievements.description: Study every animal across all states in Story Mode.
achievements.summary: Study every required animal subspecies listed under @mechanic{Pause Menu > Progress > Compendium > Animals}.

guide.context: Tracking is unnecessary, every subspecies is separate, and Guarma-exclusive parrots, boas, and the Red-footed Booby are excluded.

steps.text: Use binoculars at a safe distance, focus each unstudied animal, and hold @mechanic{Study} until its compendium entry updates.
Sweep every main-map region and study the @enemy{Cuban Land Crab} and @enemy{Green Iguana} on the largest island east of @loc{Flat Iron Lake}.
Review @mechanic{Compendium > Animals} and complete every remaining required subspecies entry.

achievements.description: Catch a fish weighing at least 16 lbs (7.3 kg).
achievements.summary: Catch a Story Mode fish weighing at least @mechanic{16 lb (7.3 kg)}, such as a qualifying legendary fish.

guide.context: The legendary-fish route required for 100% includes qualifying catches, so this can be combined with Best in the West.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Jeremy Gill} on the northeast shore of @loc{Flat Iron Lake} to start @mechanic{A Fisher of Fish}.
Buy the appropriate @item{Special Lake, River, or Swamp Lure}, catch a legendary fish, and confirm its result screen shows at least 16 lb (7.3 kg).

achievements.description: Upgrade each available component for a single sidearm or longarm weapon.
achievements.summary: Buy a changed option in every component slot for one Story Mode sidearm or longarm.

guide.context: Cosmetic metals and engravings are not component slots.

steps.text: At any gunsmith, choose @mechanic{Customize}, select one owned weapon, and open @mechanic{Components}.
For a @item{Double-Action Revolver}, change @mechanic{Grip}, @mechanic{Barrel Length}, @mechanic{Barrel Rifling}, and @mechanic{Iron Sights}, then leave the menu with all four installed.

achievements.description: Survive 18 bear attacks and kill the bear each time in Story Mode.
achievements.summary: Survive @mechanic{18 grizzly-bear maulings} and kill each bear before Arthur stands up after breaking free.

guide.context: A bear killed before it grabs Arthur or after Arthur regains his feet does not count.

steps.text: Equip an upgraded @item{Carbine Repeater} with @item{Express ammunition} and visit the grizzly spawn between @loc{Wallace Station} and @loc{Watson's Cabin} in the morning or at noon.
Approach on foot, let the bear grab Arthur, complete the break-free prompt, and shoot the bear in the head before Arthur stands.
Ride away, camp, and advance one day to reset the spawn. Repeat the complete maul, break-free, and ground-kill sequence until 18 qualifying kills register.

achievements.description: Reach max bonding level with a horse.
achievements.summary: Reach @mechanic{Bonding Level 4} with one Story Mode horse.

guide.context: The bonding screen tracks one mount at a time, so switching or losing the horse interrupts progress on the current animal.

steps.text: Keep one primary horse and ride it without exhausting its stamina.
Feed, brush, calm, and pet the same horse whenever those actions are available until @mechanic{Pause Menu > Player > Horse > Bonding} reaches Level 4.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Complete the Intro.
achievements.summary: Complete the Red Dead Online introduction through @mechanic{Honor Among Horse Thieves} and return to camp.

guide.context: The introduction is mandatory before normal Free Roam, posse, and camp-improvement features open.

steps.text: Create an Online character and complete the tutorial missions through @mechanic{Honor Among Horse Thieves}.
Return to camp and watch @npc{Cripps}'s cutscene to finish the introduction.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Take part in a Series.
achievements.summary: Finish one complete Red Dead Online @mechanic{Showdown or Race Series} match.

guide.context: Joining a lobby is insufficient; the match must reach its result screen.

steps.text: After the tutorial, open @mechanic{Pause Menu > Online}, join an available Showdown or Race Series, and remain through the end-of-match results.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Accept 10 Free Roam missions from characters around the world.
achievements.summary: Complete Red Dead Online Free Roam missions for @mechanic{10 different mission-giver characters}.

guide.context: The award counts distinct characters, not 10 repeated missions from one giver.

steps.text: In Online Free Roam, visit orange mission-giver icons and complete one mission from each new character.
In @mechanic{Awards}, open the @mechanic{Free Roam} category and watch the distinct mission-giver counter; continue until it reaches 10.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Play 5 Free Roam Events.
achievements.summary: Finish @mechanic{five Free Roam Events} after accepting their purple Red Dead Online invitations.

guide.context: Invitations expire quickly, but winning the event is unnecessary.

steps.text: Stay in Online Free Roam, accept each purple @mechanic{Free Roam Event} invitation as it appears, and remain through the result. Complete five events.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Achieve 5 gold belt buckles from awards.
achievements.summary: Complete the Gold tier of @mechanic{five Red Dead Online Awards} and receive five Gold Buckles.

guide.context: Gold is each Award's highest tier, and the Awards menu exposes the exact counter for every candidate.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Pause Menu > Progress > Awards} and select five accessible Award tracks.

Efficient options include killing one flying bird with an arrow, selling an item to three shop types, reaching maximum horse bonding, completing Free Roam missions for 10 characters, and spending $1,000 in shops.
Complete each selected Gold threshold and confirm that five Awards display Gold Buckles.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Achieve MVP 3 times (in a round with at least 4 players).
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{MVP} in three Red Dead Online match rounds containing at least @mechanic{four total players}.

guide.context: The three MVP results need not be consecutive, and the four-player requirement applies to the match rather than the player's posse.

steps.text: Join a populated standard @mechanic{Showdown Series} and play the mode's scoring or capture objective rather than pursuing unrelated kills.
Remain for the results scene and confirm that the game presents the character as @mechanic{MVP}.
Repeat in rounds with at least four players until three qualifying MVP presentations have registered; organize a PC session if public matchmaking is too sparse.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Concurrently own 5 horses.
achievements.estTime: after earning enough cash for four stalls and horses
achievements.summary: Own @mechanic{five Red Dead Online horses simultaneously} by filling five stable stalls.

guide.context: The tutorial horse fills the first stall, so four more stalls and four more horses are required.

steps.text: At a stable, keep the tutorial horse and purchase four additional stable stalls.
Buy one horse into each empty stall and confirm the stable lists five concurrently owned horses.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Reach Rank 10.
achievements.summary: Earn enough Red Dead Online XP to reach @mechanic{Rank 10}.

guide.context: Story missions, Series matches, Free Roam missions, events, and Awards all contribute XP.

steps.text: Complete the Online introduction, then earn XP from missions, Series, events, and Awards until the rank indicator reaches 10.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Reach Rank 50.
achievements.summary: Earn Red Dead Online XP until the character reaches @mechanic{Rank 50}.

guide.context: This is the longest online requirement, so the other Online achievements should be combined with its XP route.

steps.text: Complete Online story missions, Free Roam missions, Series matches, events, and Awards while clearing the other online requirements.
Continue earning XP until the rank indicator reaches @mechanic{Rank 50}.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Successfully counter a rival Posse's Free Roam mission.
achievements.summary: Personally stop a rival posse's interruptible Free Roam mission after the rival-attack notice appears.

guide.context: Both cooperating players must lead separate posses, and delivery or wagon missions are more reliable than waiting for an arbitrary mission to permit interception.

steps.text: Coordinate with one other PC player and have each player form a separate posse.
Have one posse leader start an interruptible delivery or wagon Free Roam mission from a train-station giver, then follow the route until both players receive the notice that a rival posse can attack.

As the achievement player, steal and deliver the marked objective or destroy the marked wagon exactly as instructed. If the unlock does not register, change sessions and repeat with another interruptible mission.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Purchase 5 camp improvements.
achievements.summary: Purchase @mechanic{five Red Dead Online camp improvements}, such as five different flag colors.

guide.context: Flag colors are inexpensive qualifying improvements available through camp management after the tutorial.

steps.text: Save at least $250, enter camp, focus on @npc{Cripps}, open @mechanic{Wilderness Outfitters}, and buy five different $50 flag colors in one visit.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Craft 25 pieces of ammunition.
achievements.summary: Craft @mechanic{25 pieces of ammunition} in Red Dead Online after learning an ammunition recipe.

guide.context: Repeated crafts of the same ammunition recipe count.

steps.text: Buy and read an ammunition-recipe pamphlet from a @npc{Fence}, then collect its ingredients.
Choose @mechanic{Rest > Craft/Cook > Ammunition} and produce 25 total rounds or pieces. Use the @mechanic{Craft items} counter in the Survivalist Awards category to track progress.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Form a Persistent Posse.
achievements.summary: Spend @mechanic{$200} to create a @mechanic{Persistent Posse} after finishing the Red Dead Online tutorial.

guide.context: A Temporary Posse does not qualify; the posse type must be Persistent.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Player Menu > Posse > Form a Posse}, set @mechanic{Type} to @mechanic{Persistent}, and confirm @mechanic{Form a Posse}.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Craft 20 items (excluding ammo).
achievements.summary: Craft @mechanic{20 non-ammunition items} in Red Dead Online, including repeated cooked-meat recipes.

guide.context: Repeated food outputs count, but ammunition crafts are excluded.

steps.text: Hunt and skin animals for meat, then use the campfire's @mechanic{Craft/Cook} menu.
Cook 20 pieces of meat or other non-ammunition items, checking the Survivalist crafting Award and excluding ammunition from the total.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Sell 20 items to the Butcher.
achievements.summary: Sell @mechanic{20 individual animal items} to a Red Dead Online butcher.

guide.context: Repeated item types count, and skinning animals produces multiple saleable parts in addition to the carcass.

steps.text: Hunt and skin several animals outside @loc{Valentine}, keeping the carcasses, meat, pelts, feathers, and antlers.
Sell individual items to the @npc{Valentine butcher} until 20 sales register.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Pick 25 Herbs.
achievements.summary: Pick @mechanic{25 plants} in Red Dead Online; herbs, berries, mushrooms, and flowers all count.

guide.context: Eagle Eye highlights every harvestable plant with a visible trail.

steps.text: Activate @mechanic{Eagle Eye} in Online Free Roam and harvest highlighted plants. Watch the @mechanic{Pick Herbs} counter in the Survivalist Awards category until it reaches 25.

achievements.description: Red Dead Online: Complete a Free Roam mission as part of a Posse with at least 2 members.
achievements.summary: Complete one Red Dead Online Free Roam mission while in a posse containing at least @mechanic{two members}.

guide.context: The Online tutorial must be complete before posse and Free Roam mission features become available.

steps.text: Form or join a posse with at least one other player.
Accept an orange-icon Free Roam mission, keep both players in the posse, and complete the mission objective.
